question_text: Haruffan Hausa guda bakwai da ake kira 'Bakwai Bakwai' su ne:
option_a: b, ɓ, d, ɗ, g, gw, y
option_b: a, e, i, o, u, r, t
option_c: k, kw, ky, c, ts, s, sh
option_d: m, n, r, y, w, h, l
explanation: Haruffan Hausa guda bakwai da ake kira 'Bakwai Bakwai' sune: b, ɓ, d, ɗ, g, gw, y.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Gida' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Gida' tana nufin 'house' a Turanci. Makaranta=school, Kasuwa=market, Masallaci=mosque.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Makaranta' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Makaranta' tana nufin 'school' a Turanci. Gida=house, Asibiti=hospital, Coci=church.

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, wane ne ake kira 'Sarki'?
explanation: A cikin al'adun Hausa, ana kiran sarki da 'Sarki', wanda yake nufin king, chief, ko emir.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne ya kafa Daular Sokoto?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Usman dan Fodio ne ya kafa Daular Sokoto a shekara ta 1804.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace irin rubutu ake amfani da ita?
explanation: A cikin rubutun Hausa, ana amfani da rubutun Larabci (Ajami) da rubutun Latin (Boko).

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Kasuwa' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Kasuwa' tana nufin 'market' a Turanci. Gida=house, Makaranta=school, Masallaci=mosque.

question_text: A cikin nahawun Hausa, 'Mai zuwa' tana nufin:
explanation: 'Mai zuwa' tana nufin 'the one who is coming' a Turanci (present continuous).

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace birni ce aka fi sani da 'Birnin Kano'?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, birnin Kano ne aka fi sani da 'Birnin Kano' wanda yake ɗaya daga cikin manyan biranen Hausa.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Duka ka sani, duka ka gani' tana nufin:
option_c: All you know is all you see
explanation: Karin maganar 'Duka ka sani, duka ka gani' tana nufin 'seeing is believing' a Turanci.

explanation: Kalmar 'Masallaci' tana nufin 'mosque' a Turanci. Coci=church, Haikali=temple, Wuri mai tsarki=shrine.

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, 'Bikin Aure' bikin ne na:
explanation: 'Bikin Aure' a cikin al'adun Hausa bikin aure ne (wedding ceremony).

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace mace ce ta kasance jaruma kuma sarauniya?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Sarauniya Amina ta Zazzau (Zaria) ta kasance jaruma kuma sarauniya wadda ta yi fada da yawa.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace irin rubutu ce ake kira 'Ajami'?

question_text: A cikin nahawun Hausa, 'Ya tafi' tana nufin:
explanation: 'Ya tafi' tana nufin 'he went' a Turanci (past tense).

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne ya gina birnin Daura?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Bayajidda ne ya gina birnin Daura bayan ya kashe macijin Sarki.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Idan ka ce ba za ka iya ba, to ba za ka iya ba' tana nufin:

explanation: 'Bikin Suna' a cikin al'adun Hausa bikin suna ne (naming ceremony) na yara.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne ya gina ganuwar Kano?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Sarki Muhammadu Rumfa ne ya gina ganuwar Kano da ke kewaye da birnin.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace irin rubutu ce ake kira 'Boko'?

explanation: 'Zan tafi' tana nufin 'I will go' a Turanci (future tense).

explanation: A tarihin Hausa, ana kiran birnin Zaria da 'Birnin Zazzau'.

explanation: Karin maganar 'Hankali ne mafi arziki' tana nufin hankali yana da muhimmanci fiye da arziki.

explanation: 'Bikin Sallah' a cikin al'adun Hausa bikin addini ne na musulmai (religious festival).

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace irin rubutu ce aka fara amfani da ita?
explanation: A cikin rubutun Hausa, an fara amfani da rubutun Ajami (Larabci) kafin rubutun Boko (Latin).

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Sana'a' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Sana'a' tana nufin aiki (job), kasuwanci (trade), ko sana'a (profession).

explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Usman dan Fodio ne ya yi jihadi a ƙasar Hausa a shekara ta 1804.

question_text: Karin maganar Hausa 'Kome da lokacinsa' tana nufin:
explanation: Karin maganar 'Kome da lokacinsa' tana nufin komai yana da lokacin da ya dace.

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Kudi' tana nufin:
explanation: Kalmar 'Kudi' tana nufin 'money' a Turanci. Zinariya=gold, Azurfa=silver, Arziki=wealth.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wane ne sarkin Kano da ya fara yin rubutun tarihi?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, Sarki Muhammadu Rumfa na Kano ne ya fara yin rubutun tarihi game da Kano.

question_text: A cikin rubutun Hausa, wace shekara aka fara amfani da rubutun Boko?

question_text: Kalmar Hausa 'Yaro' tana nufin:

question_text: A cikin al'adun Hausa, 'Cin Rani' shine:
explanation: 'Cin Rani' a cikin al'adun Hausa shine taimakon juna da ake yi a tsakanin manoma lokacin girbi.

question_text: A tarihin Hausa, wace birni ce ake kira 'Birnin Kanta'?
explanation: A tarihin Hausa, ana kiran birnin Gobir da 'Birnin Kanta' bayan Sarki Kanta.
